'''Heinke''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a delivery person on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he used to carry supplies to [[Spike (Serenno)/Legends|The Spike]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jahan Cross]] introduced himself as Heinke's substitute to [[Infiltration of The Spike|infiltrate]] the prison.
